This website contains all analyses for our study of right ventricular remodelling in end-stage dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM).

The study includes single-nucleus RNA sequencing of snap-frozen right ventricular tissue from **21 patients with DCM** who underwent heart transplantation and **8 healthy controls**, together with mass spectrometry and Olink Reveal proteomic profiling of right ventricular tissue from patients with DCM and healthy controls.

## Preprint

[Read the original preprint on bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.28.747817)

The original preprint describes the DCM-only study. The revised analyses on this site also include healthy control samples.
